headline: OpenAI's Luna hits all-time high; DeepSeek's new flash variant surges
summary: OpenAI/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 reached 7.9% token share—day 3 of its record run—while DeepSeek's fresh flash model (deepseek-v4-flash-20260731) debuted at rank 5 with 7.0% share. Five new entrants arrived, including Mistral AI and Qwen, as five older models exited the top 50. DeepSeek provider share jumped 3.9 points in a day, now commanding 23.7% overall.
highlights: OpenAI/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 holds all-time high at 7.9% (day 3 of streak)
DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 debuts at rank 5 with 7.0% share
DeepSeek provider share +3.9% in 24h, now 23.7% of total
OpenAI provider share +1.1% to 13.0% (gpt-5.6-luna and -terra both climbing)
Five new entrants: OpenAI/gpt-oss-20b, OpenAI/gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, OpenAI/gpt-5.4-mini-20260317, Mistral AI/mistral-nemo, Qwen/qwen3.7-flash-20260727
Five dropouts including OpenAI/text-embedding-3-small and Anthropic/claude-4.7-opus-20260416
